reason: Adds a Stage filter to the Butler board (All projects goal view). Core's GET /butler/board accepts repeatable stage=<label> and no_stage=true, matches labels case-insensitively across projects (subprojects use their nearest parent's stages via chat_work_stage), returns per-stage and no-stage counts that ignore the stage filter, and keeps the header's needs-you/working states unfiltered. The board sends the filter on the poll, Completed pages, Select all and Resume idle; Hold acts only on the filtered running chats by name; the filter is remembered on the device. Python selects the global project read tests (new stage filter/count test plus the existing Work stage and board reads), chat holds (the hold route the filtered Hold uses), and product help for the new section with the index digest. Frontend selects the board client, the Butler board page and the destination discovery test. Playwright selects area:butler-mode, whose real-Core LAN journey gains a stage-filter step; ui/playwright.config.ts restores the butler-mode spec to the assistant-real projects' testMatch, which #1207 dropped, so the catalogued area collects again.
